answer:
I found **30 papers** in the library that report their own LoCoMo results. Page numbers are PDF page positions, which can differ from the numbers printed on the pages. I scanned all 2,275 PDFs as text and excluded matches on "locomotion". I also matched "L O C O M O", the spaced small-caps spelling some papers use.

### Memory systems / methods evaluated on LoCoMo

| # | Paper | Where LoCoMo results are reported |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents** (introduces LoCoMo) | QA results for base, long-context and RAG models, Tables 2–3, p. 7; event summarization, Table 4, p. 8 |
| 2 | **A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents** | Table 1, p. 6; more backbones, Tables 5–7, pp. 16–17 |
| 3 | **Mem0** | Table 1, p. 9 (setup on p. 8) |
| 4 | **Memory-R1** | Table 1, p. 6; extended Table 3, pp. 17–18 |
| 5 | **Memory OS of AI Agent** (MemoryOS) | Table 2 and efficiency Table 3, p. 7 |
| 6 | **MemOS: A Memory OS for AI System** | Table 3, pp. 23–24 |
| 7 | **MIRIX** | Table 2, p. 11 (85.38% overall, p. 3); Table 3, p. 17 |
| 8 | **LightMem** | Table 3, p. 8 (text on p. 7) |
| 9 | **O-Mem** | Table 2, p. 8 (51.67% avg F1); ablation Table 6, p. 11 |
| 10 | **On Memory Construction and Retrieval for Personalized Conversational Agents** (SeCom) | Table 1, p. 6; Table 6, p. 18; Table 11, p. 22 |
| 11 | **Beyond RAG for Agent Memory** (xMemory) | Table 1, p. 6; ablations, pp. 17–18 |
| 12 | **Belief Memory** (BeliefMem) | Table 1, p. 7; ablation Table 3, p. 8 |
| 13 | **SAGE: A Novelty Gate…** | Tables 3–4, p. 7; Table 5, p. 8 |
| 14 | **MemMA** | Tables 2–3, p. 7 |
| 15 | **Choosing How to Remember** (FluxMem) | Table 2, p. 7; ablation Table 4, p. 8; Table 6, p. 19 |
| 16 | **Memanto** | Tables III–VI, p. 8; benchmark comparison Fig. 7, p. 9 |
| 17 | **Remember the Decision, Not the Description** (DeMem) | Table 1, p. 8; Table 2, p. 31; more on pp. 40–50 |
| 18 | **A-TMA** | Full LoCoMo Tables 3–4, p. 11 (setup on p. 10) |
| 19 | **User as Code** (UaC) | Table 1, p. 13 (78.8%); Fig. 2, p. 14; ablations, pp. 21–22 |
| 20 | **MemGuard** | Table 2, p. 7 (75.53% avg accuracy) |
| 21 | **When Memory Updates but Behavior Does Not** | LoCoMo used as a probe (p. 4); results on p. 7 (.600 → .433) |

### Benchmark or analysis papers that run systems on LoCoMo

| # | Paper | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 22 | **AgentMemBench** | Per-dataset Table 6, p. 12; discussion on p. 10 |
| 23 | **Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?** | Figs. 7–8, p. 8; backbone and drift analyses, pp. 11–12 |
| 24 | **OP-Bench** | Results on p. 5; Table 3, p. 7; Pareto plot, pp. 9–10 |
| 25 | **Toward Multi-Session Personalized Conversation** (ImplexConv) | Accuracy plot, p. 8; Table 5, p. 12 |
| 26 | **MemSyco-Bench** | Error analysis on LoCoMo samples, Fig. 3, p. 4 (method on p. 29) |

The last one is borderline: it runs a memory system on LoCoMo samples to analyse errors but doesn't report accuracy scores.

### Excluded: they mention LoCoMo but don't evaluate on it
- **Beyond Recall**: it only quotes scores that vendors reported (p. 16) and says it does not evaluate on LoCoMo (p. 133).
- **Benchmark papers** that only compare against LoCoMo in related work or a comparison table: LongMemEval (pp. 2–3), HaluMem (pp. 4–5), MemBench (p. 2), EvoMemBench (pp. 2–3), Beyond a Million Tokens (pp. 10, 17–18), the incremental multi-turn memory benchmark (pp. 2, 4), Know Me, Respond to Me (p. 10), AlpsBench, PERMA, HorizonBench, DynamicMem, PersonaMem‑v2 and v3.
- **Surveys**: for example Memory in the Age of AI Agents and Rethinking Memory in LLM-based Agents.
- **Papers that only cite it**: Mem‑α (p. 3), Reflective Memory Management (p. 2) and Control-Plane Placement (pp. 1–2).
